apiSurface:
FinQuant Hub API Surface

Router Registration (main.py line 31-34): all 14 routers registered via flat loop.

models_crud (/api/models) — Model config CRUD + test + set-default
agents (/api/agents) — Agent preset CRUD
chat (/api/chat) — Single-agent session management + SSE streaming
discussion (/api/discussion) — Multi-agent discussion rooms + SSE
market (/api/market) — Market data search/quote/kline/indicators (v1, Tencent/Sina/EastMoney)
dashboard (/api/dashboard) — Dashboard stats aggregation
analysis (/api/analysis) — Stock analysis indicators/scoring/signals/SSE research
portfolio (/api/portfolio) — Portfolio group/position CRUD + live PnL
wq (/api/wq) — WorldQuant Alpha field search + correlation
research (/api/research) — Research report SSE stream + CRUD + export
screening (/api/screening) — Multi-market stock screening (user-supplied tickers)
backtest (/api/backtest) — Legacy backtest runs (v1, synchronous)
instruments (/api/instruments) — Unified instrument research contract (v2, A/HK/US)
backtests (/api/backtests) — MA-crossover background jobs (v2, async with BackgroundTasks)

Key patterns:
- Flat registration, no router prefix collision
- Shared dependency: request.app.state.market (MarketDataService singleton from lifespan)
- SSE endpoints: chat, discussion, analysis/stock, research (4 total)
- Dual backtest API versions: v1 sync vs v2 async w/ state machine
- Dual analysis routes: /api/market/indicators (v1) vs /api/analysis/{ticker}/indicators (v2)
- All routes directly embed SQL via database.query_one/query_all/execute
- Response envelope: list endpoints wrap in {items: [...], total: N}
dataFlowDiagram:
Request Flow:
Browser → Vite Proxy → FastAPI lifespan → Router → Service → Database/External API → Response

Lifespan:
- init_db(): create tables, WAL mode, seed data (2 models + 6 agent presets)
- app.state.market = MarketDataService() (two HTTP clients: one trust_env=False for China, one trust_env=True for Yahoo)
- yield, then close db + market on shutdown

Service Call Chains:
1. Market Data: Router → MarketDataService → Tencent/Sina/EastMoney/Yahoo HTTP → parse response → return dict
   Fallback chain: quote: Tencent → Sina → Yahoo; kline: Sina → Tencent → Yahoo
2. Chat: Router → LLMClient (chat_stream) → SSE token events → persist message → done event
3. Discussion: Router → discussion_orch.stream_discussion() → round-robin LLM calls → SSE events → persist
4. Research: Router → research_orch.run_research() → 4 parallel agents → tool_use loops → SSE events → build report → done
5. Portfolio PnL: Router → portfolio.calc_pnl() → MarketDataService.quotes() → compute
6. Backtest v2: Router → BackgroundTasks → InstrumentService.bars() → ma_crossover.run_ma_crossover() → persist result
7. Analysis: Router → resolve_ticker → MarketDataService.kline() → indicators.compute() → signals.detect_all() → scoring.composite_score()

Database Writes:
- All write operations go through database.execute() which auto-commits
- Research SSE stream also does event persistence (INSERT research_events) during streaming
- Portfolio service has its own ensure_tables() call creating separate portfolios/positions tables

External Dependencies:
- EastMoney search API (A-share search)
- Tencent qt.gtimg.cn (A-share realtime quote + kline backup)
- Sina hq.sinajs.cn (A-share realtime backup + kline primary)
- Yahoo Finance v8 chart + v1 search + fundamentals-timeseries (HK/US data)
- DeepSeek API (LLM completion)

Data transformations:
- Tencent amounts in 10K units → raw values (multiply by 10,000)
- Tencent market cap in 100M units → raw values (multiply by 100,000,000)
- Sina kline GBK decode, Tencent kline GBK decode
- Yahoo bars: split/dividend adjustment via adjclose ratio
- Ticker normalization: 6-digit A-share → sh/sz prefix, 4-5 digit → hk prefix, alpha → us prefix
invariants: All 14 routers are registered in a single flat loop in main.py; no nested/prefix-based auto-discovery or mount-based registration
MarketDataService is a singleton created in lifespan, stored at app.state.market, and injected into routers via request.app.state.market
Database connection is a global singleton (_db) initialized in lifespan; get_db() asserts it exists
All router functions directly call database.query_one/query_all/execute; there is no data access layer or repository abstraction
Portfolio service creates its own tables (portfolios, positions) outside of database.py SCHEMA — two separate table creation paths
Backtest v1 router (backtest.py) also creates its own backtest_runs table inline — three separate table creation paths total
All LLM calls go through model_router.get_client() which reads model_config from DB; no hardcoded model configuration
SSE streaming always uses sse-starlette EventSourceResponse and yields event/data lines; no WebSocket path exists
ToolRegistry is a singleton pattern (__new__) but tools_definitions.py creates a module-level _registry instance — only one instance exists in practice
Chinese API calls use trust_env=False (bypass system proxy); Yahoo calls use trust_env=True (through proxy)
Research orchestrator creates the database record first, then streams SSE events; failed/interrupted runs persist in 'failed' status
All frontend API calls go through a single axios instance (api.ts) with base URL '/api'; no per-service client instances
Frontend pages use React.lazy + Suspense for code splitting; ProLayout manages sidebar navigation
Model API keys are never returned in HTTP responses — _public_model() strips api_key and adds has_api_key boolean
Backtest v2 state machine transitions: queued → loading_data → running → calculating_metrics → completed (terminal: failed, cancelled)
Signal detection dedup: _recent_unique() keeps only 1 signal per type within last 20 bars to avoid historical noise flooding
All responses assume UTF-8 charset; no explicit encoding negotiation
The analysis router uses resolve_ticker() from ticker.py; the instruments router uses external_symbol() from instruments.py — two different normalization paths for the same purpose
